{{Quote|The Tal Nami have a very interesting culture. Their bodies need two foods to survive&ndash;the fruit of the egoa tree and the root of the capabara plant.|[[DV-9]] describes the Tal Nami and their diet|<ref name="GoF2" />}}
'''Capabara plants''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] which grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tal Nami]] within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The plants were capable of growing roots that members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tal Nami (species)|Tal Nami]] species, who also lived on Tal Nami, required in their [[Diet/Legends|diet]] to survive along with the fruit of the [[egoa tree]], which grew in a separate region of the planet from the capabara plant. Their need resulted in the Tal Nami of the two different regions [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] the different plants and led them to develop a code of honor for trading which always ensured that both sides got a fair deal.<ref name="GoF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Capabara plants were first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy of Fear: City of the Dead]]'', a book released in [[1997]] as the second part of the ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Fear]]'' series written by [[John Whitman]] and aimed at young readers.<ref name="GoF2" />
